title: XYPN Team Headshots

deliverables.title: Team Headshots (20 People, Downtown Bozeman)
deliverables.description: Outdoor natural-light headshot session for 20 team members at the XYPN office downtown. Reflectors and diffusion used as needed. About 10-12 minutes per person, with live iPad review during the session.

lineItems.details: On-location shoot at the XYPN downtown office. Outdoor natural-light setup with reflectors and diffusion used as needed. About 10-12 minutes per person across 20 team members. Live iPad review during the session. One final headshot per person delivered as a full-resolution JPEG with light retouching: basic blemish cleanup, subtle skin and teeth refinement, and color correction.

deliverablesList: 20 final headshots delivered as full-resolution JPEGs via shared link
deliverables.timeline: Tuesday July 28 or Wednesday July 29. Noon start, 3.5 hours on site. Final images delivered within 1 week of the shoot.

deliverables.title: Additional Selects (+3 per person)
deliverables.description: Upgrade from one final image per person to four. Each person receives three additional edited headshots with slight variation in expression, angle, and framing.

lineItems.details: Three additional fully-retouched and color-corrected headshots per person, with variation in expression, angle, and framing. 60 additional final images total across the team.

deliverablesList: Three additional final headshots per person (4 total per team member), delivered as full-resolution JPEGs via shared link

deliverables.title: Cropped Versions (Square + Circle)

lineItems.details: Square (1:1) and circular crop exports of the primary final headshot per person (20 total). Sized for web and social use. Does not include crops of Additional Selects images if added.

deliverablesList: Square and circular crop exports of each person's primary headshot, delivered as web-optimized JPEGs
